title: Žádost o prodloužení dlouhodobého pobytu (protected, AES-128)
models: The zadost-pobyt form protected as the ipc.gov.cz fill-in forms are: AES-128 (V4, R4), an owner password only, permissions to print in high quality, fill in form fields and extract for accessibility, nothing else (P -1084). It must be read and filled like the unprotected form, and its copy must carry the same protection.
